beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: In this town, if you lie, a raincloud pops over your head and rains on you until you tell the truth.
beats.visual: Main street, sunny day. A man in sunglasses tells his neighbor something with a big fake grin. Pop: a small grey cloud appears right above his head and pours rain on only him, while everyone else stays in the sun.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Five years ago, Mayor Glossy promised everyone free ice cream.
beats.visual: Flashback: the mayor in a top hat and sash stands at a podium on the town square stage with his arms wide, and the crowd cheers. Pop: a tiny thundercloud appears over his top hat.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: He wears an umbrella hat now. Still no ice cream.
beats.visual: Present day. The mayor walks down main street in an umbrella hat under his own little lightning storm, and it's sunny everywhere else.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Mrs. Fennick asked the street if they liked her new haircut. Everyone said yes. School got cancelled. Flood.
beats.visual: A lady with an enormous tower of purple hair twirls on main street. Her neighbors give a thumbs-up with fake smiles, then pop-pop-pop-pop: a cloud appears over every single neighbor, and water rises up the street to the door handles.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Kids dance and cheer on a rooftop in the rain, celebrating no school.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Me? Never had a cloud. Not once. Top ten respect.
beats.visual: Me (black hoodie, white knight emblem, headphones) standing with crossed arms and sunglasses in a perfect circle of sunshine, smug, while every extra around me has their own little cloud. In the background Mom quietly carries a folded umbrella, glancing at the sky.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Until yesterday. Grandpa's birthday trifle went missing. All seven layers.
beats.visual: Town square party under a 'HAPPY BIRTHDAY GRANDPA' banner. Grandpa (white beard, party hat) stares at an empty trifle bowl covered in crumbs, and the whole family gasps. Mom stands to the side quietly holding a folded umbrella.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Mom looked right at me. I had custard on my face.
beats.visual: Mom (blocky woman, ponytail, cardigan) slowly turns with a squint face. Cut to a close-up of me with a big pink custard smear across my mouth and a sweat face.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: And I said... the cat did it.
beats.visual: I point at the orange cat sitting innocently on the party table. Pop: a little grey cloud appears above my head, and one drop lands on my nose.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The cat stared at me. Betrayed.
beats.visual: Slow push-in on the orange cat's face in total silence.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: So I doubled down. The cat and the pigeon. The pigeon was the brains.
beats.visual: I point at the pigeon on the stage, and the pigeon slowly turns its head, offended. My cloud doubles in size, then triples, thunder rumbles, and rain pours on me.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Lightning flashes and the camera shakes as my cloud swells over the whole town square. I stand there soaked, shouting.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: By lunch, my cloud covered the whole town. Mr. Biggs rowed to work in a bathtub.
beats.visual: Wide shot in dark storm lighting: one giant cloud over every rooftop, and blue water filling main street up to the windows. A man in a fishing hat rows a white bathtub past the street lamps with a briefcase on his lap.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Goon Squad!
beats.visual: On my roof, three friends (red cap, big glasses, party hat) pose in inflatable swim rings. The stamped word slams in.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: And a pool party on my roof.
beats.visual: The Goon Squad dances in the rain, then cannonballs off the roof into the flooded street with a huge splash.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: While they're out partying, by the way.
beats.visual: Cut down to me standing neck-deep in water on main street with the cloud pouring straight onto my head and a sad face.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I tried to tell the truth. It was m... m... the pigeon's cousin.
beats.visual: I take a deep breath, determined, then panic and point at the pigeon, who slowly turns and glares at me. A thunder clap goes off right over me.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Ah, almost... almost!
beats.visual: Close-up of my sweaty face. The stamped word slams in.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The town chanted from the rooftops. Drizzao! Pella pip! Pella plonk! Soggani!
beats.overlay: DRIZZAO! PELLA PIP! PELLA PLONK! SOGGANI!
beats.visual: Soaked townspeople on every rooftop pump their fists and chant down at me. Each word stamps onto the screen.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then, genius idea. I looked up and said: I am lying right now.
beats.visual: Silence. I point straight up at the giant cloud with a determined face, and the camera tilts up into the cloud.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The cloud froze. If I'm lying, it's true. If it's true, I'm lying.
beats.visual: The cloud flickers between rain and sunshine, sputters, spins in place, and sparks crackle across it. Everyone on the rooftops tilts their heads.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: It spun, sparked, and exploded into the biggest rainbow in town history.
beats.visual: Boom: the cloud bursts into a giant blocky rainbow arching over the clock tower. The sun comes out, the water drains away, and the crowd cheers.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: I surf down main street on the bathtub as the water drains, with the cat sitting on my head and the whole town cheering under the rainbow.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Okay. I ate the trifle. All seven layers.
beats.visual: Under the rainbow, sun out, I look at the camera and confess with a sheepish grin, custard still on my face. No cloud appears. The orange cat nods once, satisfied.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Mom hugged me. It's okay, sweetie. I'm not mad.
beats.visual: Town square under the rainbow. Mom gives me a warm hug and a gentle smile.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then... pop. Biggest storm in town history.
beats.visual: Pop: a gigantic black thundercloud appears over Mom's head, lightning everywhere and the sky going dark. Mom keeps smiling while I slowly back away with a shocked face. Screen shake.

title: In This Town — The Cat Did It
